description: This is a test class for MessageHelper, containing unit tests for the MessageHelper utility methods used within the Eclipse Hono project. It verifies behavior such as adding properties to messages, handling JSON payloads, setting default content types, TTL management, and property precedence.

classes.name: MessageHelperTest
classes.description: A JUnit 5 test class that verifies the functionality of MessageHelper utility methods related to AMQP messaging within the Eclipse Hono framework.

methods.name: testAddJmsVendorPropertiesAddsContentType
methods.description: Test that MessageHelper correctly adds JMS vendor properties when content type is set.

methods.name: testAddJmsVendorPropertiesAddsContentEncoding
methods.description: Test that MessageHelper correctly adds JMS vendor properties when content encoding is set.

methods.name: testAddJmsVendorPropertiesRejectsEmptyContentType
methods.description: Test that MessageHelper does not add properties when content type is empty.

methods.name: testAddJmsVendorPropertiesRejectsEmptyContentEncoding
methods.description: Test that MessageHelper does not add properties when content encoding is empty.

methods.name: testGetJsonPayloadHandlesMalformedJson
methods.description: Ensures MessageHelper.getJsonPayload throws DecodeException on non-JSON payload.

methods.name: testGetPayloadAsStringHandlesNonCharacterPayload
methods.description: Ensures that getting payload as string does not fail on invalid UTF-8 data.

methods.name: testGetJsonPayloadHandlesEmptyDataSection
methods.description: Verifies that getJsonPayload returns null for empty Data section.

methods.name: testAddDefaultsAddsDefaultContentType
methods.description: Checks that default content type is set from configuration if not already present.

methods.name: testAddDefaultsDoesNotAddDefaultContentType
methods.description: Checks that existing content type is preserved over defaults.

methods.name: testAddPropertiesAddsFallbackContentType
methods.description: Verifies fallback content type is applied when none is set.

methods.name: testAddPropertiesDoesNotOverrideValidMessageTtl
methods.description: Ensures message TTL is not overridden if already valid.

methods.name: testAddPropertiesAddsCustomProperties
methods.description: Verifies application of tenant and device-specific default properties, with device-level taking precedence.

methods.name: testAddPropertiesLimitsTtlToMaxValue
methods.description: Checks TTL is capped at max-ttl for tenant defaults.

methods.name: testNewMessageUsesGivenTtlValue
methods.description: Verifies message TTL is set to the device-specified value if within limits.

methods.name: testNewMessageLimitsTtlToMaxValue
methods.description: Ensures message TTL is capped at tenant max-ttl if device TTL exceeds it.
